findings.title: XSS Filter Bypass via Pure JSFuck Encoding — Dalgona xss32
findings.description: The application statically blocks all alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9) and angle brackets (<, >) in form submissions, aiming to prevent XSS. However, a pure JSFuck payload using only the characters []()!+ bypasses the filter entirely. The payload builds and executes alert('XSS') using JavaScript operator coercion without any letters or digits in the raw POST body.
findings.evidence:
Flag extracted: flag{85085a7c-07be-43ea-ba89-3db5e7523235}

Payload structure: ";[JSFuck-encoded alert('XSS')];//

The JSFuck payload (22,485 chars) uses only []()!+{} operators to:
1. Build 'fill' and 'constructor' strings from false/true coercion
2. Access the Function constructor via []['fill']['constructor']
3. Pass 'alert("XSS")' as function body string
4. Execute via wrapWithEval pattern

Verified: all chars in raw payload are in set []()!+{}[], confirmed by: grep -oE '[a-zA-Z0-9<>]' payload = empty
